Watts made this hymn from Psalm 81:1, 8–16, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob. 8Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me! 9There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god. 10I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it. 11But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me. 12So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices. 13If only My people would listen to Me, if Israel would follow My ways, 14how soon I would subdue their enemies and turn My hand against their foes! 15Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever. 16But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.” PSALM 81:1, 8–16 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 81
Sing to the Lord aloud, And make a joyful noise; God is our strength, our Saviour God; Let Israel hear his voice. STANZA I
